project.title: Native persisted one-time email verification
project.goal: Persist native issuance and atomically verify only unchanged current subject/address under an admitted writer
project.scope: Application/storage operations on trusted synthetic control handles, without HTTP/mail or legacy coexistence qualification

boundary.responsibility: Issue digest-bound current-user intent and atomically consume it to verify address
boundary.rationale: Signature alone does not establish one-time current subject authority
excludes: HTTP/mail/public acknowledgements, legacy dual writers, physical admission, deployment and full identity parity

action.email_verification.description: Issue and consume native persisted email verification

errors.refused: Fixed errors and NotCommitted/OutcomeUnknown stage; reusable only after checked rollback

preconditions: Admitted canonical control connection and trusted current workspace/key/Clock
No public native route enablement alongside authoritative legacy verify-email bypass
postconditions: Issue releases internal optional bearer only after committed digest-bound current intent
Complete atomically consumes exactly one unchanged current intent and sets email flag plus audit/telemetry
No session, credential, MFA or workspace access grant; failure rollback or explicit unknown outcome
external_effects: Canonical control verification/user/audit/telemetry transaction plus existing email_verified trigger
Trusted Clock and OS entropy; no mail/network/session creation
